messages:
Marco: Quick sync — proposing a focused Q3 compliance slice: audit observability improvements, BYOK onboarding automation, and SOC2 evidence packaging. Trying to keep MVP small to unblock pilot customers.
Sara: Can you list the MVP items?
Marco: MVP candidates:
- audit export v1 (JSONL + manifest, s3 export + search index)
- BYOK onboarding API + minimal UI for keystore handshake (no escrow yet)
- evidence bundle export for SOC2 (bundle + integrity manifest)
Also small item: retention label mapping in tenant config UI.
Kevin: Agree with small scope. Need to confirm encryption/KMS acceptance criteria for SOC2.
Liz: Ops question — what SLA for evidence retrieval? 24h or 72h?
Dan: Customers are asking for 48h at minimum; banks want 24h. Sales pushing 24h for FinServ pilot.
Sara: From infra complexity: 24h is fine for ad-hoc exports, but search-backed fast queries for large spans is harder. For MVP we can guarantee export generation within 48h for <1TB query.
Kevin: Security asks: must include signed manifest with keyid, signature, and sha256 per file. Also retention metadata (creation_ts, retention_until).
Marco: OK acceptance criteria draft (quick):
```
- Audit export: JSONL files with per-line event, gzipped, with manifest.json containing sha256 checksums + signer keyid.
- BYOK API: POST /tenants/{t}/keystore/handshake -> returns token; minimal UI to upload customer public key and thumbprint.
- Evidence bundle: zip of artifacts + manifest, downloadable via console or S3 link.
- SLA: export generation <=48h for <=1TB; retrieval link valid 7 days.
- Retention mapping: tenant config exposes retention_days and retention_tier label.
```
Liz: Ops note: need playbook for emergency legal-hold override. That’s out of scope for MVP but must be a non-blocker for pilots.
Kevin: Also add audit log integrity checks on ingest (ingest signer) so we can prove non-repudiation for SOC2 auditors.
Sara: Implementation plan idea: incremental rollout across infra regions. Phase 1: export producer + manifest writer; Phase 2: keystore handshake + UI; Phase 3: evidence bundle + signed manifests.
Marco: Timeline ask: phase 1 & 2 in 6 wks, phase 3 in 10 wks. Is that realistic?
Sara: 6 wks for 1+2 if we scope UI minimal and reuse existing export pipeline. Need 2 engineers full time + 1 security reviewer.
Dan: I'll flag to pilot customers that 48h SLA for now, 24h for pilot eval on case-by-case.
Kevin: I'll draft acceptance checklist for auditors — will include key rotation notes, signature verification steps, and retention proofs.
Marco: Risk log: 1) key escrow negotiation, 2) export size / cost, 3) legal hold playbook missing. Need owners.
Liz: Ops can own legal hold playbook outline (owner: Liz).
Sara: I'll own implementation (owner: Sara).
Kevin: Security owner for audit manifest & verification: Kevin.
Marco: Action items: @Sara scope tasks + estimate by EOD Friday; @Kevin produce auditor checklist draft by Monday; @Dan notify pilot customers about 48h baseline.
Dan: on it — will send short note to pilot list today. :+1:
infra-bot: Deploy pipeline check: export-producer image build successful on ci-42, canary deploy blocked until infra review.
Marco: Thanks — follow-ups in this thread. If anyone objects to scope, call it out here.
Kevin: LGTM from security side with items tracked.
Sara: LGTM but will push back if estimates change.
Liz: LGTM from ops.
Dan: thumbs up from sales side. :rocket:
